Name: George Whitefield
Summary: English evangelist and close associate of the Wesleys who preached the new birth to vast open-air crowds on both sides of the Atlantic and founded the Bethesda orphanage in Georgia.
Contribution: Carried the Great Awakening across Britain and America, preaching outdoors to crowds of thousands and founding orphanages and schools.
Testimony: He testified to the new birth as the heart of Christianity and spent his life urging hearers to be born again.
